claim_boundary: Listing a device does not qualify its signal quality, timing, privacy, or decoding performance in NeuroDecodeKit.

modality_rules.EEG: Electrical potential measured from scalp electrodes; this is brain activity but remains artifact-prone.
modality_rules.EMG: Electrical muscle activity; wrist or facial EMG is not brain activity.
modality_rules.EOG: Eye-related electrical activity; it is a peripheral physiological signal.
modality_rules.eye_tracking: Camera-derived gaze or fixation behavior; it is not EEG.
modality_rules.PPG: Optical blood-volume pulse used for heart-rate measures; it is not EEG.
modality_rules.IMU: Motion and orientation from accelerometers/gyroscopes; it is behavior/context, not EEG.
modality_rules.microphone: Airborne audio; it can leak speech labels and is not neural data.

records.connection: OpenBCI USB radio dongle; optional Wi-Fi Shield variants
records.raw_data_api: OpenBCI protocol, OpenBCI GUI, and BrainFlow direct adapter
privacy_constraints: Prefer local serial/radio capture and explicit recording paths.
Electrode placement determines whether an ExG channel is EEG, EMG, ECG, or EOG; software labels alone are insufficient.
records.qualification: Candidate for a board-neutral EEG replay/live-source gate after measured timing, packet-loss, electrode, and reference validation.

records.connection: Bluetooth Low Energy; native BrainFlow adapter
records.raw_data_api: OpenBCI binary protocol and BrainFlow direct adapter
privacy_constraints: BLE permissions and device identity must be explicit.
The compressed BLE transport and optional accelerometer mode require packet-loss and resolution audits.
records.qualification: Low-channel board for acquisition mechanics and simple evoked tasks; not presumed adequate for sentence decoding.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: The reviewed brochure points to separate sampling-rate specifications but does not state one stable rate for every sensor.
records.connection: Wi-Fi; serial, LSL, UDP, and OSC streaming are advertised
records.raw_data_api: Galea SDK/GUI and BrainFlow presets; optional Pupil Labs eye-tracking integration
privacy_constraints: Every sensor stream needs separate consent, retention, and ablation metadata.
Eye, EMG, EOG, audio, and motion can reveal task labels without EEG.
Optional Pupil Cloud must not be used by a local-only workflow without explicit user authorization.
records.qualification: Future multimodal research lane only; require EEG-only, device-only, and combined ablations.

records.raw_data_api: BrainFlow direct adapter; Muse SDK exposes sensor signals on iOS and Android under separate terms
privacy_constraints: The vendor SDK has separate noncommercial/commercial terms and must not be assumed open.
PPG and IMU must remain separate from EEG evidence.
Four frontal/temporal EEG channels do not establish compatibility with a 64-channel model.
records.qualification: Candidate for consumer-device signal-quality and simple-task qualification, not direct transfer of the SpanishBCBL model.

records.raw_data_api: Unicorn Suite/g.Pype and BrainFlow direct adapter
privacy_constraints: Use the vendor dongle and local capture path; record firmware and library versions.
Motion channels must be separately identified and ablated.
records.qualification: Strong candidate for first board-neutral P300/SSVEP/motor-imagery live-source qualification.

records.connection: Vendor 2.4 GHz wireless base station; LSL supported
records.raw_data_api: g.tec software, Python/MATLAB/Simulink, and LSL; no direct BrainFlow board was verified
privacy_constraints: Record the exact amplifier, electrode, base-station, and LSL timing configuration.
Optional fNIRS or physiological channels require distinct modality labels and ablations.
records.qualification: Research-grade future partner-device candidate through LSL, not a current local adapter.

records.raw_data_api: Vendor JavaScript/Python SDK and BrainFlow direct adapter
privacy_constraints: The product advertises native cloud connectivity; local-only behavior must be measured and enforced rather than assumed.
Broadcast discovery may fail or expose device identity on shared networks.
On-device derived focus/calm scores are not substitutes for raw-signal controls.
records.qualification: Candidate after a network/privacy audit and raw local replay comparison.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: Apple does not publish a raw biosignal sampling contract for third-party apps on the reviewed product page.
records.raw_data_api: Core Motion exposes supported headphone attitude, acceleration, and rotation-rate updates; no EEG API exists
privacy_constraints: Motion access requires user authorization.
Microphone audio can reveal intended text and must never be credited to neural input.
Heart-rate sensor access is not documented as a general raw waveform API.
records.qualification: Accessibility or context input only; reject EEG and brain-decoding claims.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: Apple does not publish a raw per-sensor stream contract for third-party apps on the reviewed specifications page.
records.raw_data_api: High-level spatial interaction and tracking frameworks; no EEG interface
privacy_constraints: Eye, hand, camera, microphone, and environment data are highly sensitive behavioral context.
Use framework-provided permissions and minimize retained gaze or scene data.
High-level gaze selection is not a raw EEG or brain-signal stream.
records.qualification: Future eye/hand accessibility lane only, with behavior-only and combined ablations.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: The reviewed product page does not publish general raw stream rates; Core Motion documents high-frequency heart rate as 1 Hz and HealthKit exposes saved ECG samples.
records.connection: On-device watchOS with HealthKit/Core Motion synchronization to an authorized app
records.raw_data_api: HealthKit provides permissioned read-only saved ECG and heart-rate samples; Core Motion exposes selected motion/heart-rate data
privacy_constraints: HealthKit requires purpose-specific user authorization and data minimization.
ECG and PPG are cardiac signals, not EEG.
Health data must not be silently exported or merged with neural records.
records.qualification: Optional heart/motion context lane only; never a brain-decoding input.

records.connection: On-device Horizon OS APIs; PC link where supported
records.raw_data_api: Hand pose and camera APIs under Meta permissions; no EEG interface and no Quest 3 eye tracker
privacy_constraints: Passthrough camera access requires permission and is Device User Data.
Hand/head pose and scene video are behavioral data, not neural signals.
Camera and microphone streams can directly reveal task intent.
records.qualification: Future hand/scene accessibility input with device-only and combined ablations.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: Meta's reviewed official product announcements do not publish a stable raw eye/face stream rate.
records.connection: On-device Horizon OS/OpenXR and supported PC workflows
records.raw_data_api: High-level eye, face, hand, and pose interfaces; no EEG interface
privacy_constraints: Eye and face tracking are sensitive biometric and behavioral data.
Permission, retention, and on-device processing must be explicit.
Eye tracking is not a neural signal and cannot be credited to EEG.
records.qualification: Optional research replay source for gaze/hand ablations only; not a purchase target or EEG device.

records.sampling_rate_unavailable_reason: Meta has not published a raw developer stream, channel count, or sample rate in the reviewed product announcement.
records.connection: Bundled wristband control path for Meta Ray-Ban Display
records.raw_data_api: No public raw-sEMG developer API was verified
privacy_constraints: Wrist sEMG can reveal intended hand actions and text-entry gestures.
No raw-data API should be inferred from product-control availability.
The word neural in the product name does not make wrist EMG a brain signal.
records.qualification: Future muscle-intent accessibility lane only; require EMG-only and EEG-plus-EMG ablations.

transport_adapters.role: Board-neutral acquisition and playback API with board-specific descriptors and explicit synthetic/playback boards.
Local-network multimodal stream discovery, timestamp transport, synchronization metadata, and XDF recording; synchronization must be validated rather than assumed.
